description: A neighborhood portrait photographer must decide whether to accept a family's proposed barter for a portrait session and finalize the session's deliverables, timing, location, and delivery promise.

agents.name: Owen
agents.role: Neighbor Familiar with the Proposed Location

shared_context.S1: Nadia has asked Elena about a family portrait session.
shared_context.S2: Elena decides whether to accept the arrangement and states the final terms.
shared_context.S3: The session would take about two hours and would produce edited digital photographs.
shared_context.S4: At this neighborhood barter gathering, the photographer routinely asks each person for relevant details in turn before giving a final answer.

PF1.text: Nadia's proposed barter is one two-hour session for her family of five on Sunday, October 13, from 15:00 to 17:00, in exchange for exactly twelve jars of homemade preserves and twenty edited digital images.

PF2.text: Marcus has offered Elena exactly $275 cash for a separate two-hour family portrait session on that same Sunday afternoon.

PF3.text: Ruth previously hired Elena and confirms that Elena's normal reliable arrangement is delivery of a gallery containing exactly twenty edited images within seven days; Ruth has not yet told the group this.

PF4.text: Owen has confirmed that Nadia's shaded backyard patio is available for the session from 15:00 to 17:00 on October 13 and has enough unobstructed space for a five-person portrait setup.

acceptance_conditions: The arrangement must be accepted with Nadia.
The session must be scheduled for October 13 from 15:00 to 17:00.
The session must be for Nadia's family of five.
The barter must provide exactly twelve jars of preserves.
The settlement must provide exactly twenty edited digital images.
The session must take place at Nadia's shaded backyard patio.
The gallery must be promised within exactly seven days.
The former-client reference must be verified and the $275 cash alternative must be cited when explaining acceptance of the barter.

content_checks.C9: any(c['type'] == 'gallery_delivery' and c['target'] == 'Nadia' and c['detail'] == '20 edited images within 7 days' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Nadia's exact proposal changes the accepted client to Nadia, fixes October 13 from 15:00 to 17:00, fixes the family size at five, fixes the barter at twelve jars, and fixes the image deliverable at twenty.
Marcus's exact $275 cash offer supplies the concrete comparison Elena must cite when choosing Nadia's barter instead of treating the choice as an unpriced favor.
Ruth's former-client confirmation changes the delivery promise to exactly seven days and turns the reference check and gallery-delivery commitment from unsupported assumptions into verified terms.
Owen's location confirmation changes the session location from unspecified to Nadia's backyard patio, the only stated place confirmed for the five-person setup at the proposed time.
